English (遊戲原文): The base fighter-type in The Bard's Tale, warriors can use nearly every weapon there is. For every 4 levels of experience after the 1st, Warriors get an extra attack ability in combat.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 作為《冰城傳奇》的核心戰鬥職業，戰士可以使用幾乎所有類型的武器。自 1 級之後，戰士每升 4 級即可在戰鬥中獲得一次額外攻擊機會。

English (遊戲原文): Paladins are fighters who have sworn to abstain from all evil and to uphold honor and purity in all places. They can use most weapons and some that no other fighters can. They get multiple attacks at higher levels. They also have a greatly increased resistance to evil magic.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 聖騎士是發誓遠離一切邪惡，並在世間捍衛榮譽與純潔的戰士。他們能使用絕大多數的武器，甚至包含其他戰鬥職業無法企及的神聖兵刃。隨著等級提升，他們將獲得多次攻擊的能力；此外，他們對邪惡魔法也擁有極高的抗性。

English (遊戲原文): A professional thief with so-so combat ability, the rogue can hide in shadows, and leap out at distant enemies to land critical hits. They can also search for traps and disarm them. Without a rogue your party will pay very dearly for the booty it wins.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 盜賊是戰鬥能力平平的專業竊賊，但他們能潛藏於陰影之中，並飛躍突襲遠處的敵人以造成致命一擊。他們也能搜尋並解除陷阱。如果隊伍中沒有盜賊，你們為了奪取戰利品而付出的代價，將會無比慘痛。

English (遊戲原文): The Bard is a wandering minstrel. You'll see them with a tankard of ale in front of them in the less reputable taverns -- the rowdier the better. Their song magic can help your party immensely in and out of combat.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 吟遊詩人是四處漂泊的流浪樂師。你經常能看見他們端著大口麥酒，混跡在那些名聲狼藉的酒館裡——而且地方越喧鬧，他們就越自在。他們的歌聲蘊含著神祕魔力，無論在戰鬥中或冒險旅途上，都能為你的隊伍帶來無比巨大的助益。

English (遊戲原文): An assassin, a mercenary, a ninja. The hunter can use most weapons, and has the ability (which grows with experience) to do critical hits in combat (i.e., to attack a nerve center or other vital area and instantly kill an opponent). A good skill.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他是刺客，是僱傭兵，也是忍者。獵人能熟練使用絕大多數的武器，並擁有隨經驗增長而提升的「致命一擊」能力（意即能精準打擊神經中樞或其他要害，瞬間擊殺對手）。這是一門相當了得的本領。

English (遊戲原文): A martial artist, an almost inhuman fighting machine trained to fight without weapons or armor. The monk can use them, but, at higher levels particularly, often does better without.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他是武術大師，是個受過嚴苛訓練、在不穿盔甲也不帶武器時仍形同非人般恐怖的戰鬥機器。武僧雖然可以使用裝備，但特別是在高等級之後，赤手空拳的他們往往能發揮出更強大的戰力。

English (遊戲原文): Conjurers deal in the physical creation and manifestation of real things (like fire, light, healing).
Chinese (請填寫中文): 幻術師擅長將實體物質具現化。他們能憑空創造並召喚出真實存在之物（例如火焰、光芒與治癒神蹟）。

English (遊戲原文): Magicians deal with magic as it affects physical objects (i.e., enchanting a sword, making armor stronger, making a dungeon wall disappear).
Chinese (請填寫中文): 魔術師精通改變物質型態與附加附魔的法術。他們能對實體目標施加魔力影響（例如：為長劍附魔、強化盔甲的防禦力，或是令地下城的牆壁憑空消失）。

English (遊戲原文): Sorcerers are magic users who deal with the creation and manipulation of illusion. Due to the power of sorcerer spells, this class is not available to newly created characters.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 術士是專精於創造與操控幻象的施法者。由於術士法術蘊含的威力過於強大，此職業並不開放給初出茅廬的新創角色。

English (遊戲原文): Wizards are magic users who are dedicated to the summoning and binding of various supernatural creatures. These creatures are not friendly to humankind and trying to control them is extremely hazardous. The Wizard-class is not available to new characters either.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 巫師是潛心於召喚與束縛各類超自然生物的施法者。這些異界生物對人類毫無友善之情，試圖掌控牠們是極其凶險的舉動。與術士相同，巫師職業同樣不開放給初出茅廬的新角色。

English (遊戲原文): These magic users have learned at least three levels for each of the previous four magic user classes. The Archmage is one of the most powerful and important characters in The Destiny Knight because an Archmage can do almost anything. Remember, Lagoth Zanta is an Archmage... fight fire with fire.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 大魔導師是指在先前四種施法者職業中，每一門都至少研習至第 3 階（級）以上的魔法大師。大魔導師是《命運騎士》中最強大且最關鍵的角色之一，因為他們幾乎無所不能。請牢記，大魔王拉哥斯·贊塔也是一名大魔導師……想要擊敗他，你就得以毒攻毒，以烈火對抗烈火。

English (遊戲原文): Chronomancers are the travel experts of the magic users. Before becoming one, a magic user must master all the spells of any three mage classes. And once you become a Chronomancer, you lose the power to use all the spells you previously learned. It may sound unfair, but the Chronomancer needs to focus all of his or her attention on the important dimension teleport spells. Don't think you can get around without this spellcaster, because you just can't.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 時空術士是所有施法者當中的「旅者專家」。在晉升此職業前，施法者必須先精通任意三種法師職業的所有咒語。然而，一旦你成為時空術士，你將會失去先前習得的所有法術。這聽起來或許有些不公，但時空術士必須將所有的專注力，投注在至關重要的維度傳送法術上。千萬別以為沒有這位施法者你也能闖蕩世界——因為你根本寸步難行。

English (遊戲原文): Fighters who want to convert to a life of a magic can become Geomancers. Once they choose to change, they can still use the armor, weapons, and magic items that the fighter classes use. Beware: Bards lose their songs, Warriors lose their multiple attacks, Hunters lose their critical hit ability, and Monks lose their armor class bonus and multiple attacks. It's part of the trade off. To become a Geomancer, you must find the one special location that performs the rite of passage to this mage class.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 渴望皈依魔法之道的戰鬥職業，可以轉職為「大地術士」。一旦選擇轉變，他們仍可繼續裝備戰士階級所使用的盔甲、武器與魔法道具。然而切記：轉職後，吟遊詩人將失去吟唱樂曲的能力、戰士會失去多次攻擊的技巧、獵人將失去致命一擊的本領，而武僧則會失去防禦防具加成與多次攻擊的優勢。這便是力量交換的代價。想要成為大地術士，你必須在世間尋獲那處舉行此法系晉升儀式的專屬祕境。

English (遊戲原文): While possibly being of hardier stock, this character is nonetheless like you or me.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「儘管他們的體魄或許更為強健，但這類角色本質上就如同你我一般，只是個普通人。」

English (遊戲原文): Patterned after the Tolkien elf, the elf is slight of build, frequently taller and nimbler than a human, and very inclined to magic.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「精靈是以托爾金筆下的形象為藍本塑造。他們身形纖細，通常比人類更為高挑與敏捷，且天生對魔法有著極高的親和力。」

English (遊戲原文): The Dwarven people are short and stout, extremely strong and healthy, but not amazingly intelligent (i.e. excellent fighters).
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「矮人一族身材矮小而粗壯，他們擁有極其強悍的怪力與健康體魄，但在智力方面的表現就沒那麼驚人了（換句話說，他們是無可挑剔的頂尖戰士）。」

English (遊戲原文): Hobbits are slightly smaller than Dwarves but are nimble and dexterous. Just the right make-up for a rogue.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「哈比人的體型比矮人還要稍顯嬌小，但他們身手極其矯健且心思靈巧。這般天賦異稟的體質，簡直是為了成為盜賊而量身打造。」

English (遊戲原文): These crossbreeds are usually blond and fair-skinned, like elves, and get some added size and strength from their human ancestry.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「這些混血兒通常擁有如精靈般耀眼的金色髮絲與白皙膚色，同時也從人類的血統中，繼承了更為高大的身形與強健的力量。」

English (遊戲原文): An orc is a large, goblin-like creature often found working for evil wizards. The Half-orc, being half human, is not quite as despicable as his orc parent, but you wouldn't want to date one. They are tough but incredibly stupid.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「獸人是一種體型龐大、外貌酷似哥布林的生物，經常被發現受僱於邪惡的巫師。而半獸人因為擁有一半的人類血統，雖然不像他們的獸人父母那般面目可憎，但你絕對不會想跟他們約會。他們皮糙肉厚，卻也蠢得無可救藥。」

English (遊戲原文): Gnomes closely resemble dwarves, but have less hair and even shorter tempers. They are also more magically inclined, as a rule. Highly intelligent but not very robust.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「地精的外貌與矮人極其相似，但他們的毛髮較少，脾氣也更為暴躁。一般而言，他們對魔法有著更高的天賦。雖然智力超群，但他們的體魄卻相當脆弱。」

English (遊戲原文): Strength is physical power and chiefly affects the amount of damage a character can do to an opponent in hand-to-hand combat. Make sure your fighting characters are strong.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 力量代表角色的肉體勁道。它主要影響角色在近身肉搏戰中，能對敵人造成多少傷害。請務必確保你隊伍中的戰鬥職業擁有強健的力量。

English (遊戲原文): Intelligence is mental power. A high intelligence will enable your magic users to get bonus spell points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 智力代表角色的精神心智力量。卓越的智力能讓你的施法者獲得額外的法力值加成。

English (遊戲原文): Measures agility & nimbleness. A high score makes your characters harder to hit and helps them strike the first blow in combat.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 本項數值用以評估角色的身手與靈敏度。高昂的敏捷度不僅能讓角色更難被敵人擊中，還能助他們在戰鬥中搶佔先機、率先出招。

English (遊戲原文): Measures healthiness. It takes more damage to kill a character with a high constitution score. This is reflected in bonus "hit points", the character's life span.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 本項數值用以評估角色的健康與強韌度。體質優異的角色需要承受更多傷害才會倒下，這將直接體現於額外的「生命值」加成上，亦即延展了角色的生命極限。

English (遊戲原文): Luck is an ambiguous attribute, as it has a number of unseen effects on gameplay. For example, lucky characters are more likely to resist evil magic and avoid nasty traps.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 幸運是一項難以捉摸的屬性，因為它對遊戲過程有著諸多潛移默化的隱形影響。舉例來說，受到命運眷顧的角色，將更有機會抵抗邪惡魔法的侵襲，並完美避開那些陰險毒辣的機關陷阱。

English (遊戲原文): Hit Points measure the damage a character can take before they are killed. The current status is shown in the characters status bar, followed by their current maximum potential.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 生命值用以衡量角色在力竭戰死前所能承受的傷害總量。當前的生命狀態會顯示在角色的狀態欄中，其後則會標註他們目前所能達到的最大生命潛能值。

English (遊戲原文): This shows current spell point status. Points are used up with each cast of a magic spell. If a Conjurer has 20 spell points and casts a Mage Flame spell at a cost of 2 spell points, his new total would be 18. The characters status line lists both their current and maximum spell points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 本項數值顯示當前的法力值狀態。每當施展魔法咒語時，便會消耗相應的點數。舉例來說：若一名幻術師擁有 20 點法力值，並施展了消耗 2 點法力的「法師之火」咒語，其剩餘的法力總量將會變為 18 點。角色的狀態欄會同時列出他們當前的法力值與最大法力上限。

Chinese (請填寫中文): 該項目已被識別！也許Roscoe可以告訴你更多...

Chinese (請填寫中文): 你無法在此地施展奧秘傳門！

Chinese (請填寫中文): 有 50% 的幾率平息隊伍中任何或所有變得敵對的怪物。

Chinese (請填寫中文): 法師隊伍的成員都將獲得完美的夜視能力，並且無限期持續。你敏銳的視力還可以讓你辨識秘密之門。

English (遊戲原文): Causes a group of your enemies to fear you greatly, lessening their morale and their ability to hit and damage you.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使你的一群敵人非常害怕你，降低他們的士氣以及攻擊和傷害你的能力。

English (遊戲原文): This incantation is very likely to instantly kill one selected enemy, big or small.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個咒語很可能會瞬間殺死選定的一個或大或小的敵人。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will do {0}-{1} points of damage to a single demon. The power to summon is the power to destroy.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 該法術將對單一惡魔造成{0}-{1}點傷害。召喚的力量就是毀滅的力量。

English (遊戲原文): This spell works like Demon Bane, but it will affect an entire group of demons.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個法術的作用類似於惡魔剋星，但它會影響整個惡魔群體。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will reveal the true nature of any illusion attacking the party, causing it to instantly vanish.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 該法術將揭示任何攻擊該方的幻象的真實本質，使其立即消失。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will make any possessed party member return to their normal state.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術將使任何被附身的隊員恢復正常狀態。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will destroy any illusion fighting the party, and any new illusions created later in the combat. It will also point out any doppelgangers in the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 該法術將摧毀與隊伍戰鬥的任何幻象，以及戰鬥後期創建的任何新幻象。它還會指出黨內的任何分身。

English (遊戲原文): This powerful spell earns its name by doing the following: 1) Turns illusionary characters into real characters; 2) Cures characters of all illnesses but age; and 3) Restores all hit points to the party. If you're in combat, it also does the following: 1) Lowers your armor class, saving throw, to hit, and damage by 20 points; 2) Increases your attack by eight points; and 3) Casts Mangar's Mallet.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個強大的咒語因執行以下操作而得名：1）將幻象角色變成真實角色； 2）治療除老年以外的一切疾病； 3) 恢復隊伍的所有生命值。如果你在戰鬥中，它還會執行以下操作：1）降低你的護甲等級、豁免檢定、命中率和傷害 20 點； 2）攻擊力增加8點； 3) 鑄造曼加爾的木槌。

English (遊戲原文): Allows the mage to breathe fire at a group of foes, doing {0}-{1} points of damage to each.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 允許法師向一群敵人噴火，對每個敵人造成{0}-{1}點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): This powerful spell earns its name by doing the following: 1) Turns illusionary characters into real characters; 2) Cures characters of all illnesses but age; and 3) Restores all hit points to the party. If you're in combat, it also does the following: 1) Lowers your armor class, saving throw, to hit, and damage by 20 points; 2) Increases your attack by eight points; and 3) Casts Mangar's Mallet. When used out of combat, the Dreamspell can be used to escape the current dungeon.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個強大的咒語因執行以下操作而得名：1）將幻象角色變成真實角色； 2）治療除老年以外的一切疾病； 3) 恢復隊伍的所有生命值。如果你在戰鬥中，它還會執行以下操作：1）降低你的護甲等級、豁免檢定、命中率和傷害 20 點； 2）攻擊力增加8點； 3) 鑄造曼加爾的木槌。當在戰鬥之外使用時，夢咒可以用來逃離當前的地下城。

English (遊戲原文): Cuts down the enemy with holy daggers for 200 to 800 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 用聖匕首砍倒敵人，造成 200 到 800 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Summons an Earth Elemental, which is a creature created from the raw elements of the earth.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 召喚土元素，這是一種由地球的原始元素創造的生物。

English (遊戲原文): Commands the ground beneath the enemy's feet to open wide and drop the foes in, so they're never seen again.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 命令敵人腳下的地面張開，將敵人扔進去，這樣他們就再也看不見了。

English (遊戲原文): Reveals all booby-trapped areas that can injure the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 揭露所有可能傷害隊伍的誘殺區域。

English (遊戲原文): Casts the Trap Zap spell on the entire level.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 對整個關卡施放陷阱電擊法術。

English (遊戲原文): This incantation will cause a real ogre to appear and join the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個咒語會讓真正的食人魔出現並加入隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): Materializes a slayer who joins your party. What's a slayer? The name speaks for itself...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 出現一個加入你隊伍的殺手。什麼是殺手？這個名字不言自明......

English (遊戲原文): With this spell the caster can make a real wolf appear and join the party, fighting in its defense.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 透過這個法術，施法者可以讓一隻真正的狼出現並加入隊伍，為它的防禦而戰。

English (遊戲原文): Lands a cone of gravitational energy on a group of your foes, inflicting {0}-{1} points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 將錐形重力能量落在一群敵人身上，造成{0}-{1}點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Launches a chilling ice missile against a group of foes, inflicting 100-400 damage points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 向一群敵人發射一枚冰冷飛彈，造成 100-400 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): A long-range spell that drops a distant foe dead in its tracks.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一種遠程法術，可以將遠處的敵人擊斃。

English (遊戲原文): Pushes a group of foes 40 feet further away from your party, up to a total distance of 90 feet.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 將一群敵人推離你的隊伍 40 英尺，總距離達 90 英尺。

English (遊戲原文): Crushes the enemy under an unearthly gravitational force for 400-1500 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在超自然的重力作用下粉碎敵人，造成 400-1500 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Creates a cyclone of flame that lashes out and delivers {0}-{1} points of damage to a group of your foes.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 製造一股火焰旋風，向一群敵人猛烈攻擊，造成{0}-{1}點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): This spell behaves like the "Flesh Restore" spell, except that it will affect every member of the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術的作用類似於「血肉恢復」法術，只不過它會影響隊伍中的每個成員。

English (遊戲原文): This powerful healing spell will restore {0}-{1} hit points to a party member and cure poisoning and insanity.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個強大的治療法術將為隊員恢復{0}-{1}點生命值並治癒中毒和精神錯亂。

English (遊戲原文): Casts Witherfist and Sandstorm for a double offensive punch.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使用威瑟拳頭和沙風進行雙重攻擊。

English (遊戲原文): This spell binds your enemies with a magical force, slowing their movements and making them easier to hit.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個法術用魔法力量束縛你的敵人，減慢他們的移動速度，讓他們更容易被擊中。

English (遊戲原文): Blasts the enemy with a deadly frost for 50 to 400 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 用致命的冰霜爆炸敵人，造成 50 到 400 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Bids a shadowy wraith to unwillingly join your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 邀請一個陰暗的幽靈不情願地加入你的隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): Instills tremendous power in your party, increasing their strike ability by 10.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 為你的隊伍注入巨大的力量，將他們的攻擊能力提高 10 點。

English (遊戲原文): This survival spell lets your party breathe under water. It is cumulative in effect; casting it more than once will extend the amount of time you can spend underwater.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個生存咒語可以讓你的隊伍在水下噴吐。它的效果是累積的；多次施放它會延長你在水下的時間。

English (遊戲原文): Impales the enemy with an icy stalagmite, causing 400 to 1600 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 用冰冷的石筍刺穿敵人，造成 400 到 1600 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): A holy spell where blazing red fires are sent from the angry gods to roast the enemy for 60 to 240 damage points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 憤怒的諸神發出熾熱的紅色火焰，烘烤敵人，造成 60 至 240 點傷害的神聖法術。

English (遊戲原文): The finest in offensive obliteration, this spell annihilates the opponent for around 2000 damage points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這是進攻性消滅中最好的法術，可以消滅對手約 2000 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Casts Beyond Death and Regeneration for a life-giving combination of spells.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 施展超越死亡和重生以獲得賦予生命的法術組合。

English (遊戲原文): Like a "Lesser Revelation" spell, only it illuminates a wider area.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 就像「小啟示」咒語一樣，只是它照亮了更廣泛的區域。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will gate a greater demon into our universe and bind him to the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個咒語將把一個更強大的惡魔關進我們的宇宙，並將他束縛在隊伍中。

English (遊戲原文): A Beyond Death spell that resurrects every dead party member (except those turned to stone), and heals all wounds, paralysis, and insanity."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一種超越死亡的法術，可以復活所有死去的隊員（除了那些變成石頭的），並治癒所有傷口、麻痺和精神錯亂。 」

English (遊戲原文): A spray of water will emanate from the mage's fingers, doing 6-24 points of damage to any undead foe (e.g. skeleton, zombie, vampire).
Chinese (請填寫中文): 法師的手指會噴出水霧，對任何不死敵人（如骷髏、殭屍、吸血鬼）造成 6-24 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): If successfully cast, this spell will make a group of your enemies miss the next combat round.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 如果成功施展，該法術將使你的一群敵人錯過下一輪戰鬥。

English (遊戲原文): Pummels a group of monsters with chunks of ice, causing 20-80 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 用冰塊猛擊一群怪物，造成 20-80 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Cast this spell on something to find out just what the heck it is.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 對某物施放這個咒語，看看它到底是什麼。

English (遊戲原文): Wrenches the earth below the enemy, smashing them to the ground and gives them a jolting electrical shock to cause 400-1600 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 扭動敵人下方的土地，將他們摔倒在地，並給予他們震動電擊，造成 400-1600 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): A Compass of shimmering magelight appears above the party, telling the direction they face.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個閃爍著法光的指南針出現在隊伍上方，告訴他們所面對的方向。

English (遊戲原文): This invocation will perform a Vanishing Spell on the entire party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此呼叫將對整個隊伍執行消失咒。

English (遊戲原文): The mage casting this spell will turn nearly invisible in the eyes of their enemies, who will have great difficulty in striking them.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 施展此法術的法師將在敵人眼中變得幾乎隱形，而敵人將很難攻擊他們。

English (遊戲原文): This is an extended "Mage Flame" spell which also reveals secret doors.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這是一個擴展的「法師火焰」法術，也可以揭示秘密之門。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will gate into our universe a lower power elemental or demon, who will (under protest) join the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個咒語將進入我們的宇宙，一個較低能量的元素或惡魔，他們將（在抗議下）加入隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): Partially negates the effect of gravity on the party, giving a 75% chance to avoid traps and allowing them to travel up through portals.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 部分抵消重力對隊伍的影響，有 75% 的幾率避免陷阱並允許他們通過傳送門向上移動。

English (遊戲原文): In a state of magically-heightened awareness, the spell caster will be able to sense a trap within 30 feet, if they face it.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在魔法增強意識狀態下，施法者將能夠感知 30 英尺內的陷阱（如果他們面對陷阱）。

English (遊戲原文): Increases your chances of hitting or defending by eight points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使你的擊球或防守機會增加八分。

English (遊戲原文): A small, mobile "torch" will appear, and float above the caster as they travel.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 將會出現一個小型的移動“火炬”，並在施法者行進時漂浮在施法者上方。

English (遊戲原文): Makes a party member's hands (or weapon) more deadly, adding 4-16 points of damage to every wound they inflict.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使隊伍成員的手（或武器）更加致命，他們造成的每個傷口都會增加 4-16 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Assaults a group of opposing spellcasters and may do one of the following: inflict {0}-{1} points of damage, turn them to stone, or kill them outright. However, because the maelstrom is illusionary in nature, a disbelieving enemy can totally nullify it.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 攻擊一群敵方施法者，並可以執行以下操作之一：造成{0}-{1}點傷害，將他們變成石頭，或直接殺死他們。然而，由於漩渦本質上是虛幻的，不信的敵人可以將其完全消除。

English (遊戲原文): Burns a group of foes with a blast of hot, fiery magma for 300-1200 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 用一股熾熱的岩漿燒傷一群敵人，造成 300-1200 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): This will make the party levitate, as does the level 3 spell, but its effects will last until dispelled.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這將使隊伍懸浮起來，就像 3 級法術一樣，但其效果將持續到被驅散為止。

English (遊戲原文): Inflicts 200-800 bone-crushing damage points against every monster group you face.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 對你面對的每個怪物群造成 200-800 點碎骨傷害。

English (遊戲原文): A sharp explosion of psychic energy that inflicts {0}-{1} points of damage to each and every enemy you face.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 靈能能量的急劇爆炸，對你面對的每個敵人造成{0}-{1}點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): A higher power "Mind Jab", does 3-12 points of damage to one foe, times the experience level of the mage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 威力更高的“心靈刺擊”，對一名敵人造成 3-12 點傷害，傷害值是法師經驗等級的倍數。

English (遊戲原文): The mage casts a concentrated blast of psychic energy at one opponent doing 2-8 points of damage for each experience level of the mage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 法師向一名對手施放集中的精神能量衝擊波，對法師的每個經驗等級造成 2-8 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Pull an attacking group into melee range (10') regardless of how far they were when they began attacking.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 將攻擊組拉入近戰範圍 (10')，無論開始攻擊時距離多遠。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will make a member of your party go totally insane. Useful for possessions.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個咒語會讓你的隊伍中的一個成員徹底瘋狂。對財物有用。

English (遊戲原文): Increases the armor protection of each party member by enhancing their armor's natural strength by magic.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 透過魔法增強護甲的自然強度來增加每位隊員的護甲保護。

English (遊戲原文): If successful, this spell causes every attacking group to do nothing during the next round.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 如果成功，該法術會導致所有攻擊組在下一輪中什麼也不做。

English (遊戲原文): Allows a member of your party to damage monsters as if they were as incredibly strong as an ogre.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 允許你的隊伍成員傷害怪物，就好像它們像食人魔一樣強大。

English (遊戲原文): An instant map, this shows the entire maze that the party's in.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一張即時地圖，顯示了隊伍所在的整個迷宮。

English (遊戲原文): Turns an enemy up to 60 feet away into the hardest stone.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 將 60 英尺外的敵人變成最堅硬的石頭。

English (遊戲原文): The entire party will seem to waver and blur in the sight of the monsters, making the party very difficult to strike.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 整個隊伍在怪物的視線中都會顯得動搖和模糊，使得隊伍難以被攻擊。

English (遊戲原文): This incantation will alter the structure of almost any wall directly in front of the party, turning it to air for exactly 1 move.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個咒語將改變隊伍正前方的幾乎所有牆壁的結構，將其變成空氣正好 1 步。

English (遊戲原文): This spell hurls porcupine-sharp needles from the mages finger into a selected monster, poisoning it.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 該法術將豪豬鋒利的針從法師的手指中投擲到選定的怪物中，使其中毒。

English (遊戲原文): Keeps the enemy from being able to summon any creatures.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 阻止敵人召喚任何生物。

English (遊戲原文): Has a 80% chance of preventing enemies from summoning creatures.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 有 80% 的幾率阻止敵人召喚生物。

English (遊戲原文): This spell gates in a medium level elemental or demon, to fight with the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術會進入中等等級的元素或惡魔，與隊伍戰鬥。

English (遊戲原文): Regenerates 8 hit points for a character, up to the character's maximum hit point level.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 為角色恢復 8 點生命值，最高可達角色的最大生命值等級。

English (遊戲原文): Return to the Wilderness from Arboria.
Return from Gelidia to the Wilderness.
Return from Kinestia to the Wilderness.
Return the party from Lucencia to the Wilderness.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 將隊伍從盧森西亞帶回荒野。

English (遊戲原文): Return from Malefia to the Wilderness.
Return the party from Tarmitia to the Wilderness.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 將隊伍從塔米提亞帶回荒野。

English (遊戲原文): Return to the Wilderness from Tenebrosia.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 從特內布羅西亞返回荒野。

English (遊戲原文): A health spell that revives all the hit points for one lucky member of the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一種健康咒語，可以恢復隊伍中一名幸運成員的所有生命值。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will do 16-80 points of damage to a group of undead creatures.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 該法術將對一群不死生物造成 16-80 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Makes all wounds disappear as your entire party is reforged into unflawed bodies. Also cures poisoning and insanity.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 當你的整個隊伍被重鑄為完美的身體時，所有的傷口都會消失。還能治療中毒和精神錯亂。

English (遊戲原文): Rakes enemies with shards of ice, inflicting 50 to 200 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 用冰碎片掃掠敵人，造成 50 到 200 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Reveals to the party where the anti-magic areas are.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 向隊伍揭示反魔法區域的位置。

English (遊戲原文): Causes all metal near the party to glow with magical light, illuminating the surrounding area.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使隊伍附近的所有金屬發出魔法光芒，照亮周圍區域。

English (遊戲原文): Makes all stone and earth within range of the party glow with magical light, revealing even secret doors.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使隊伍範圍內的所有石頭和泥土都發出魔法光芒，甚至顯露出秘密之門。

English (遊戲原文): Teleports your entire party to the Adventurers' Guild, minus all gold. Use this spell only in dire emergencies.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 將你的整個隊伍傳送到冒險家公會，減去所有金幣。僅在極度緊急的情況下才使用此法術。

English (遊戲原文): Shows all mage regeneration squares, so your spellcasters can be refreshed.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 顯示所有法師再生方塊，以便您的施法者可以恢復活力。

English (遊戲原文): With a violent swirl of sand, all foes are whipped back 60 feet.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 隨著一陣猛烈的沙塵漩渦，所有敵人都被擊退 60 英尺。

English (遊戲原文): The walls themselves will speak, under direction of this spell, revealing to the spell caster their location in the labyrinth. This spell works even in areas resistant to magic.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在該法術的指導下，牆壁本身會說話，向施法者揭示它們在迷宮中的位置。即使在對魔法有抵抗力的區域，該法術也能發揮作用。

English (遊戲原文): The mage will experience heightened awareness and be able to sense stairways, special encounters, spell negation zones, traps and other unusual occurrences.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 法師將體驗到更高的意識，並能夠感知樓梯、特殊遭遇、法術無效區域、陷阱和其他不尋常的事件。

English (遊戲原文): Casts a gray shadow around the party, and lowers their armor class by 4.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在隊伍周圍投射出灰色陰影，並將他們的護甲等級降低 4 點。

English (遊戲原文): A large globe of intense electrical energy envelops a group of enemies, doing {0}-{1} points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個巨大的強烈電能球包圍了一群敵人，造成{0}-{1}點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): The mage is protected by an invisible "shield" of magic, that turns aside many blows that would otherwise hit them.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 法師受到無形的魔法「護盾」的保護，可以擋開許多原本會擊中他們的打擊。

English (遊戲原文): This spell functions the same as the Second Sight spell, but it will last indefinitely.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術的作用與第二視覺法術相同，但它會無限期地持續。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will drain a single enemy of {0}-{1} points of damage, as if touched by a spectre.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術會對單一敵人造成{0}-{1}點傷害，就像被幽靈觸碰一樣。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will gate in a higher-level undead creature to fight for the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 該法術將召喚出更高等級的不死生物來為隊伍而戰。

English (遊戲原文): The air surrounding a group of your enemies will instantly ignite, causing them to be burnt for 6-24 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一群敵人周圍的空氣會立即被點燃，導致他們被燒傷，造成 6-24 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Takes a character who has been turned to stone and restores him to his natural flesh state.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 將一個已經變成石頭的角色恢復到自然的肉體狀態。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will turn an enemy to stone, but won't affect a creature already made of stone.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 該法術會將敵人變成石頭，但不會影響已經由石頭製成的生物。

English (遊戲原文): Whips out a tendril of psionic (mind) power to strike a selected foe, inflicting {0} to {1} damage points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 抽出一股靈能（心靈）力量來攻擊選定的敵人，造成{0}到{1}點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): An electric spell that gives the enemy a high-voltage zap for 50 to 200 damage points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一種電法術，可以對敵人造成 50 到 200 點傷害的高壓電擊。

English (遊戲原文): Shows all heal-party squares, so your party can put an end to their weakness and pain.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 顯示所有治癒隊伍方塊，以便你的隊伍可以結束他們的弱點和痛苦。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will gate into our universe a zombie or skeleton to fight for the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個咒語將把殭屍或骷髏帶入我們的宇宙，為隊伍而戰。

English (遊戲原文): Creates a fire-being from the raw elements of the universe to join and fight for your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 用宇宙的原始元素創造出一個火焰生物來加入你的隊伍並為此而戰。

English (遊戲原文): Summons Herb to join your party. Herb is really busy, but he'll hang out with your party for a while if you need him.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 召喚赫伯加入你的隊伍。赫伯真的很忙，但如果你需要他，他會和你的隊伍一起出去玩一段時間。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will bring a medium level undead creature into the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個法術會將一個中等等級的不死生物帶入隊伍中。

English (遊戲原文): A magical illusion appears in the party. Unable to attack, it will serve to draw enemy attacks to himself.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 聚會中出現了神奇的幻象。無法攻擊，就會吸引敵人的攻擊到自己身上。

English (遊戲原文): The brothers are always ready to help friends in trouble. Enough brothers appear to fill the empty slots in your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 兄弟倆總是樂於幫助有困難的朋友。足夠多的兄弟出現來填補你隊伍中的空缺。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will disarm any trap within 30 feet, in the direction the party is facing. It will also disarm traps on chests.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 該法術將解除隊伍所面對方向 30 英尺內的任何陷阱。它還會解除箱子上的陷阱。

English (遊戲原文): Fries all foes with wickedly hot flames for 150 to 600 points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 用熾熱的火焰將所有敵人煎炸 150 到 600 點。

English (遊戲原文): Invigorates a character by healing 4 to 8 hit points times the spellcaster's level.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 透過治療 4 到 8 點生命值乘以施法者等級來恢復角色活力。

English (遊戲原文): This spell causes the weapon (or hands) of a party member to be covered with a magical field, which causes them to do an additional 2-8 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術使隊伍成員的武器（或手）被魔法場覆蓋，造成額外 2-8 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): An electric spell that creates a pyrotechnical storm over a group of monsters, inflicting {0} to {1} damage points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一種電法術，可在一群怪物上空製造煙火風暴，造成{0}到{1}點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Dissolve the dungeon wall that the party if facing. Lasts until the party leaves the dungeon.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 溶解隊伍所面對的地下城牆。持續到隊伍離開地下城為止。

English (遊戲原文): Causes a spray of energy to spring from the caster's extended finger, sizzling a group of opponents for {0}-{1} points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 讓施法者伸出的手指噴射能量噴霧，對一群敵人造成{0}-{1}點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): This incantation will create an illusionary red dragon to fight with your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個咒語將創造一條虛幻的紅龍與你的隊伍一起戰鬥。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will create an illusionary storm giant, to join with, and fight for, your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 該法術將創造一個虛幻的風暴巨人，加入你的隊伍並為此而戰。

English (遊戲原文): Creates an illusionary hero to join your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 創造一個幻象英雄來加入你的隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): Creates an illusionary Archmage to join your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 創造一個虛幻的大法師來加入你的隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will create the illusion of an ogre, which will accompany and fight with your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 該法術會產生食人魔的幻象，它會陪伴你的隊伍並與你一起戰鬥。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will create the illusion of a battle-ready warrior that joins your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 該法術將創造出一名做好戰鬥準備的戰士加入你的隊伍的幻象。

English (遊戲原文): This spell creates an illusionary wolf to join the party. This and other illusions are only effective as long as an enemy "believes" them. Depending on power and location, the monster may see through the illusion, and cause it to vanish.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 該法術會創造出一隻幻影狼來加入隊伍。這種幻象和其他幻像只有在敵人「相信」它們時才有效。根據力量和位置的不同，怪物可能會看穿幻象，並使其消失。

English (遊戲原文): Any foe at whom this spell is cast is likely to be turned old, thus reducing their ability to attack and defend in combat.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 任何施放此法術的敵人都可能變老，從而降低他們在戰鬥中攻擊和防禦的能力。

English (遊戲原文): Crushes a group of enemies under a huge fist of power for 300 to 600 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 用巨大的力量拳頭粉碎一群敵人，造成 300 到 600 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Creates a wall of force that travels with the party and absorbs many of the enemy's attacks.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 創造一道力量之牆，與隊伍一起行進並吸收敵人的許多攻擊。

English (遊戲原文): This incantation will make a group of your enemies shake in fear, reducing their ability to attack and do damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個咒語會讓你的一群敵人因恐懼而顫抖，降低他們的攻擊和造成傷害的能力。

English (遊戲原文): With the utterance of a single word the spell caster can cure a party member of minor wounds, healing {0}-{1} points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 施法者只要說出一個詞，就能治癒一名隊員的輕傷，治療{0}-{1}點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Makes a member of your party fight with the strength and accuracy of ancient Norse heroes for the entire combat.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 讓你的隊伍成員在整個戰鬥中以古代挪威英雄的力量和準確性進行戰鬥。

English (遊戲原文): The air in front of the party will bind itself into metallic hardness, and will accompany the party when it moves, as a sort of invisible "shield".
Chinese (請填寫中文): 隊伍前方的空氣會自我束縛成金屬般的硬度，並在隊伍移動時伴隨著隊伍，成為一種無形的「護盾」。

English (遊戲原文): Causes an effect like "Air Armor" to cover every member of the party, lasting indefinitely.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 造成類似「空氣裝甲」的效果，覆蓋隊伍中的每個成員，並無限期持續。

English (遊戲原文): Coats a character with a light, fragrant lotion to cure oldness.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 為角色塗上一層淡香的乳液，以治癒老化。

English (遊戲原文): This appears to be the old stables, now converted into a storage space since the horses were eaten long ago when Mangar's ghastly creatures roamed the streets.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這似乎是舊馬厩，現在變成了儲藏室，因為很久以前，當曼加爾的可怕生物在街上閒逛時，馬匹就被吃掉了。

English (遊戲原文): Looks pretty empty at the moment.\nWould you like to leave some items here?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 目前看起來很空。 \n您想在這裡留下一些物品嗎？

English (遊戲原文): Would you like to inspect the place for items, or drop off some of your own?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 您想檢查該地方是否有物品，或放下一些您自己的物品？

English (遊戲原文): Who would like to inspect the items to take?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 誰想檢查要帶走的物品？

English (遊戲原文): Who would like to leave some items in the storage house?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 誰想把一些物品留在儲藏室裡？

English (遊戲原文): Your inventory is full. You must drop some items to make space.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你的庫存已滿。您必須放下一些物品以騰出空間。

English (遊戲原文): {0} has no unequipped items to leave...

Chinese (請填寫中文): 你在 Hawk Scabard 街上
你在 Bard Blazon 街上

English (遊戲原文): As you enter the guild, you catch the eye of the Guild Master.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 當你進入公會時，你引起了會長的注意。 \n\n

English (遊戲原文): "Well met, brave adventurer, but you come in the most dire of times."\n\n"The evil wizard, Mangar, has cursed our town with this blizzard, and the streets are overrun with all matter of evil miscreants."
Chinese (請填寫中文): “很高興見到你，勇敢的冒險家，但你在最可怕的時刻到來了。”\n\n“邪惡的巫師曼加爾用這場暴風雪詛咒了我們的城鎮，街道上到處都是邪惡的惡棍。”

English (遊戲原文): "You must help us defeat Mangar! In this guild you will find many skilled warriors and mages that would join you in this quest."\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「你必須幫助我們擊敗曼加爾！在這個公會中你會發現許多熟練的戰士和法師會加入你的任務。」\n\n

English (遊戲原文): "When your party is ready, set out into town. Be sure to visit Garth's Shoppe to the north and equip yourself for battle. He has the finest weapons and armour in Skara Brae, and indeed is the only shoppe brave enough to open these days!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「當你的隊伍準備好後，出發進城。一定要參觀北邊的加斯裝備店，並為戰鬥做好準備。他擁有斯卡拉布雷最好的武器和盔甲，而且確實是這些天唯一有勇氣開業的商店！”

English (遊戲原文): "The city has an abundance of temples that are open night and day to heal your wounds, and I believe Roscoe is still doing good business restoring magic points for your mages."\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「這座城市有大量的寺廟，日夜開放，可以治癒你的傷口，我相信Roscoe仍然在為你的法師恢復魔法點方面做得很好。」\n\n

English (遊戲原文): "And when your bard gets thirsty, be sure to visit one of the many Inns and Taverns. The Scarlet Bard, to the south, has the best selection in town!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「當你的吟遊詩人口渴時，一定要前往眾多旅館和酒館之一。位於南方的猩紅吟遊詩人有鎮上最好的選擇！”

English (遊戲原文): "Now I will bid you good day and good luck in your quest!"\n\nThe guild master smiles and returns to what he was doing.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「現在我要向你道個美好的一天，祝你的任務好運！」\n\n公會會長微笑著，繼續他正在做的事情。

English (遊戲原文): You have stepped out into the town of Skara Brae for the first time. Would you like a quick tutorial on the game controls before you proceed?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 您第一次踏入斯卡拉布雷鎮。在繼續之前，您想了解有關遊戲控制的快速教學嗎？

English (遊戲原文): Use W,A,S,D to move around the town, or the cursor keys. You can also left click on the game view to move around.\n\nHold down right mouse on the game view and you can look around to take in the view.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使用 W、A、S、D 在城鎮中移動，或使用遊標鍵。您也可以左鍵點擊遊戲視圖來移動。 \n\n在遊戲視圖上按住滑鼠右鍵，您可以環顧四周以查看視圖。

English (遊戲原文): There is a Pause button at the top left of the game view that gives access to graphics, audio and game settings, as well as saving or loading the game.\n\nThere is an Actions button on the top right of the game view that will drop down a ribbon of actions to choose from. These actions are not usable during game events.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 遊戲視圖的左上角有一個「暫停」按鈕，可以存取圖形、音訊和遊戲設置，以及儲存或載入遊戲。 \n\n遊戲視圖的右上角有一個「動作」按鈕，可以從下拉式選單中選擇操作。這些動作在遊戲活動期間不可用。

English (遊戲原文): You can change the speed that combat messages scroll by pressing the 'greater than' and 'less than' keys, or by adjusting the slider in the 'game settings' menu.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 您可以按下「<」和「>」鍵或調整「遊戲設定」選單中的滑桿來變更戰鬥訊息滾動的速度。

English (遊戲原文):
Pressing 1 to 7 lets you view the stats of one of your party members.

If you left click and drag with your mouse on one of the party member names below, you can change their position in the party. Only the first 4 character slots can be hit by enemy melee attacks.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
按 1 到 7 可查看一名隊伍成員的統計資料。 

如果您在下面的隊伍成員姓名上左鍵點擊並拖曳滑鼠，您可以變更他們在隊伍中的位置。敵人的近戰攻擊只能擊中前 4 個角色位置。

English (遊戲原文): You should try to keep a character slot free so that you can summon creatures or allow roving monsters to join your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你應該試著在隊伍中留出一個空位，以便在冒險中召喚魔法生物，或是接納沿途流浪前來投靠的怪物加入你的陣營。

English (遊戲原文): Below the game view, totals of your party's gold and inventory items are shown.\n\nAny item that is not equipped by a character will go into the communal inventory and is accessible through any player's inventory screen.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 遊戲視圖下方會顯示您隊伍的黃金和庫存物品總數。 \n\n角色未裝備的任何物品都將進入公共庫存，並且可以透過任何玩家的庫存畫面存取。

English (遊戲原文): That is all... Now go and stop Mangar!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 就這些了……現在就去阻止曼加爾吧！

English (遊戲原文): You have entered the home of Longinus the Mad. He is busy writing in a tome, but lowers his quill as he sees you entering, then abruptly rises to greet you.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你已經進入瘋子朗吉努斯的家了。他正忙著寫書，但看到你進來時放下了羽毛筆，然後突然站起來迎接你。

English (遊戲原文): The home of Longinus the Mad.
Longinus looks away and mumbles,\n\n"Go then, if you were even here, for I was not..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 朗吉努斯移開視線，咕噥道：“那就走吧，如果你還在這兒的話，因為我沒有……”

English (遊戲原文): He is lost in thought for a moment, then looks at you and proclaims\n\n"Twice will the Lestradae come for Caith... once for gold and once for faith."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他陷入了沉思，然後看著你，宣布\n\n“雷力量拉德將兩次為凱斯而來……一次是為了黃金，一次是為了信仰。”

English (遊戲原文): Twice will the Lestradae come for Caith... once for gold and once for faith.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 雷斯垂德將兩次為凱斯而來……一次是為了黃金，一次是為了信仰。

English (遊戲原文): He withdraws into himself, and looking down, mutters\n\n"Summer follows Winter, Darkness follows Day, Singing follows Sorrow, as they stride through Skara Brae."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他退回到自己的世界，低下頭，嘀咕著\n\n“夏天跟隨冬天，黑暗跟隨白天，歌聲跟隨悲傷，他們大步穿過斯卡拉布雷。”

English (遊戲原文): Summer follows Winter, Darkness follows Day, Singing follows Sorrow, as they stride through Skara Brae.

Chinese (請填寫中文): 你站在一扇鎖著的鐵門前。 \n\n它有一個形狀不尋常的鑰匙孔。它看起來幾乎是…石頭形狀的。

English (遊戲原文): You place the WardStone you found on Saradon's corpse, within the shaped hole. The gate opens to let you pass.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你將在薩拉頓屍體上找到的沃德石放置在異形孔內。門打開讓你通過。

English (遊戲原文):
You stand on the ground level of Saradon's house.
A note on a table reads: 

"Adventurers, if you are reading this then I was unable to return to you and am surely dead... In my workshop upstairs you will find information crucial to your success. I have some modest magical measures protecting my workshop, but I'm sure they will be no match for you."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
你站在薩拉頓房子的一層。 
桌子上有一張紙條，上面寫著：

“冒險家們，如果你們正在閱讀這篇文章，那麼我就無法回到你們身邊了，而且我肯定已經死了……在我樓上的工作室裡，你們會找到對你們成功至關重要的信息。我有一些溫和的魔法措施保護我的工作室，但我確信它們不是你們的對手。”

English (遊戲原文): You stand in the upper level of Saradon's house.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你站在薩拉登房子的上層。

English (遊戲原文): You inspect the bookshelf but can't find anything worthwhile.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你檢查了書架，但找不到任何有價值的東西。

English (遊戲原文): You search the scattered notes throughout the house but can't find anything worthwhile.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你搜遍了房子裡散落的筆記，卻找不到任何有價值的東西。

English (遊戲原文): You open the chest but can't find anything worthwhile.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你打開箱子卻找不到任何有價值的東西。

English (遊戲原文): You read the scribbles but can't decipher the words.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你讀了潦草的字跡，卻無法辨認其中的文字。

English (遊戲原文): You inspect the manual but can't find anything worthwhile.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 您檢查了手冊，但找不到任何有價值的內容。

English (遊戲原文): You search the writings for meaning and get vague clues about Longinus the Mad.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你在文獻中尋找意義，並得到了有關瘋子朗吉努斯的模糊線索。

English (遊戲原文): A mage standing by a large stone.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個法師站在一塊大石頭旁邊。

English (遊戲原文):
A mage, standing by a large stone, blocks your way. He says:

"Tell me two things you knuckleheads, to split the stone."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
一個法師站在一塊大石頭旁邊擋住了你的路。他說：

「告訴我兩件事，你們這些笨蛋，劈開石頭。」

English (遊戲原文): And what is the second word?
The mage makes a gesture and with a great cracking sound, the stone splits revealing a dark passage...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 法師做了個手勢，伴隨著一聲巨大的爆裂聲，石頭裂開了，露出了一條黑暗的通道…

English (遊戲原文): A large stone in the city square with a large crevice.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 城市廣場上的一塊大石頭，有一個大裂縫。

English (遊戲原文): You stand before a large stone set in the city square. On one side is a crevice, leading into darkness. A mage stands beside the crevice, watching your actions but does not block your passage.\n\nYou can:
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你站在城市廣場上的一塊大石頭前。一側有一條裂縫，通往黑暗。一名法師站在裂縫旁邊，注視著你的行動，但不會阻擋你的通道。 \n\n你可以：

English (遊戲原文): "Seek the answer in the tombs, but don't return here until you finish the crypt."\n\nThe mage disappears.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「在墳墓中尋找答案，但在完成地窖之前不要返回這裡。」\n\n法師消失了。

English (遊戲原文):
You stand in the entry to Oscon's Fortress.

A stairway leads to the upper levels.

You can:
Chinese (請填寫中文):
你站在奧斯康要塞的入口處。 

有一個樓梯通往上層。 

你可以：

English (遊戲原文): You stand in the entry to Oscon's Fortress.\n\nYou see no entrance to the upper levels.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你站在奧斯康堡壘的入口處。 \n\n你看不到上層的入口。

English (遊戲原文): There are stairs leading down into the Maze of Dread.

A magic mouth appears and says:

"Where steel is bright and blood runs red...
Walk down the stairs to the maze of..."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
一張神奇的嘴出現並說道：

“鋼鐵是明亮的，血是紅色的......
走下樓梯，到達......的迷宮”

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall shouts:\n\n"Turn back, adventurers - you are not the first and won't be the last to attempt to save the Princess!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的一張魔法嘴喊道：\n\n“冒險者們，回頭吧——你不是第一個也不會是最後一個嘗試拯救公主的人！”

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall says:\n\n"Well, you've certainly lived up to my expectations... I'm sure the King will be most pleased with a dead princess..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的一張魔法嘴說道：\n\n“好吧，你確實沒有辜負我的期望……我相信國王會對死去的公主感到最滿意……”

English (遊戲原文):
A magic mouth on the wall says:

"The Princess! You rescued her! I was wrong...

This never happens..."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
牆上有一張魔法嘴說：

“公主！你救了她！我錯了......

這永遠不會發生......”

English (遊戲原文):
An old man appears and speaks to you, saying:

"Below you now, thrice count the floors
play some light for the double doors."

He then vanishes.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
一位老人出現並對你說話，說：

「現在在你下面，數三次樓層
為雙門打開一些燈光。」

然後他消失了。

English (遊戲原文):
In the room beyond the dark.
Lies the bite behind the bark.
To avoid a gruesome fate.
Line your arrow true and straight.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
在黑暗之外的房間裡。 
樹皮後面有咬傷。 
為了避免可怕的命運。 
把你的箭拉得筆直。

English (遊戲原文): The door here looks as if something was trying to get out.\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡的門看起來好像有東西想要出去。 \n

English (遊戲原文): Beware the creature that lies in the middle of darkness...\n

There are some scribblings on the wall.

"The Princess lives..."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
牆上有一些塗鴉。 

「公主活著…」

English (遊戲原文): The blood-stained wall shows that many battles have been fought here.\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 血跡斑斑的牆壁顯示這裡曾發生過多次戰鬥。 \n

English (遊戲原文): In areas unpassable, seek entrance by Phase Door to learn the secret of the double doors...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在無法通行的區域，尋找相位門進入，了解雙門的秘密…

English (遊戲原文): A larged winged creature offers to join up with you.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一隻長著翅膀的大生物主動提出與你會合。

English (遊戲原文): Scrawled on the wall is a message:\n\n"Mangar was here..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上潦草地寫著一則訊息：\n\n“曼加爾曾在這裡…”

English (遊戲原文): A sign on the wall says:\n\n"MONSTER REFORMATORY"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的標誌寫著：\n\n“怪物改造所”

English (遊戲原文): A strange message is written on the wall:\n\n"SAMEN NGHOINT"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上寫著一則奇怪的訊息：\n\n“SAMEN NGHOINT”

English (遊戲原文):
One level down.
Map wall and door.
Look toward the corners.
And read the four...
Chinese (請填寫中文):
下一層。 
繪製牆壁和門的地圖。 
朝角落看。 
並閱讀四個...

English (遊戲原文): A voice whispers:\n\n"Ask the wise one of THE TOMBS."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音低聲說：\n\n“去問問古墓中的智者吧。”

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks:\n\n"Speak the word to pass by:"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的一張魔嘴會說話：\n\n“說出要經過的字：”

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks:\n\n"Look at the spells of the Sorcerous kind; Who's the Master of the Mind?"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的一張魔嘴說道：\n\n“看看巫師的咒語；誰是心靈的主人？”

English (遊戲原文):
A magic mouth on the wall speaks:

"You have returned. I will grant your exit again."

A faint but familiar sound is heard in the distance.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
牆上的一張魔嘴說道：

「你回來了，我會再次準許你出去。」

遠處傳來微弱但熟悉的聲音。
一個標誌上寫著：\n\n前方有樓梯。

English (遊戲原文): A corpse is here with a tombstone marked: Hotwind.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一具屍體，墓碑上寫著：熱風。

English (遊戲原文): The answer to the double doors lies hidden above.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 雙門的答案就隱藏在上面。

English (遊戲原文): A voice proclaims:\n\n"The winged one can traverse the gap."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音宣稱：\n\n“有翅膀的人可以穿過縫隙。”

English (遊戲原文): Two huge double doors block your path to the north.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 兩扇巨大的雙門擋住了你向北的道路。

English (遊戲原文): Two huge double doors to the north open at the sound of the Watchwood Melody.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 北面的兩扇巨大的雙門在《守望伍德旋律》的聲音中打開。

English (遊戲原文): Two huge double doors to the north open at the sound of the Seekers Ballad.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 北面的兩扇巨大的雙門在探索者民謠的聲音中打開。

English (遊戲原文): There is a chasm ahead, blocking any further progress.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 前方有一道鴻溝，阻礙任何進一步的進展。

English (遊戲原文): The Winged Creature carries you over the chasm which lies before you.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 有翼生物將帶你跨越眼前的鴻溝。

English (遊戲原文): There is a princess here. She really wants to be rescued.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一位公主。她真的很想被拯救。

English (遊戲原文):
You've entered the throne room of the Dark Lord. He doesn't sound pleased to see you.

"Destroy these scum! he screams."

His friends advance on you hungrily.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
你已經進入黑魔王的王座室了。他看起來並不高興見到你。 

「消滅這些敗類！他尖叫著。」

他的朋友們飢腸轆轆地向你逼近。

English (遊戲原文): A deep chasm can be seen to the north.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 北邊可以看到一條深深的裂痕。 \n\n

English (遊戲原文): "Greetings, mortals.\n\nThese tombs are a trap for the unwary. Take care you do not perish as a result of your carelessness..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「你們好，凡人。\n\n這些墳墓對於粗心的人來說是一個陷阱。小心，不要因為你的粗心而滅亡…」

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you saying this:\n\n"Things change, even unnoticed, and not always for the better."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上有一張神奇的嘴對你說：\n\n“事情會發生變化，即使你沒有註意到，但並不總是變得更好。”

English (遊戲原文): A living statue stands before you saying:\n\n"Name the city -- P......."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一座活生生的雕像矗立在你面前，說：\n\n“命名這座城市——P.......”

English (遊戲原文): "Know this then, the first Snare lies on the third level of the tombs."\n\nHe suddenly vanishes.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「那你要知道，第一個陷阱位於墳墓的第三層。」\n\n他突然消失了。

English (遊戲原文):
A living statue stands before you saying:

"The first Snare lies on the third level of the tombs."

He suddenly vanishes.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
一座活生生的雕像站在你面前，說：

「第一個圈套位於墳墓的第三層。」

他突然消失了。

English (遊戲原文): On the wall is etched this poem:\n\nThe Snare of Death right spins in whole...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上刻著這首詩：\n\n死亡網羅整體旋轉…

English (遊戲原文): ... as fire-ones feast on the dead man's soul...
Chinese (請填寫中文): ……就像火焰吞噬死者的靈魂一樣…

English (遊戲原文): ... yet savage words can cut the rock...
Chinese (請填寫中文): ……然而野蠻的言語可以切割岩石...

English (遊戲原文): ... and feathers split the headsman's block.
On the wall, scrawled in blood, is this message:\n\n"Look, oh ye mighty, and despair. The tombs are not..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上用血潦草地寫著這樣的訊息：\n\n“看，哦，你們強大，絕望。墳墓不是…”

English (遊戲原文): A voice whispers:\n\n"After the toxic one, check yourselves for a special thing that appears common..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音低聲說道：\n\n“在有毒的之後，檢查一下自己是否有一種看似常見的特殊事物......”

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth appears and says:\n\n"If the spell of dreams you seek, five magic words you must speak."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一張魔法嘴出現並說道：\n\n“如果你尋求夢境咒語，你必須說出五個魔法詞。”

English (遊戲原文): An old Keymaster is here trying to sell me something.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一位老鑰匙大師在這裡想向我推銷一些東西。

English (遊戲原文): An old man is here, and says to you:\n\n"I am the Keymaster, I have something to sell you for the low price of 50,000 gold pieces."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一位老人在這裡對你說：\n\n“我是鑰匙大師，我有東西要低價賣給你，五萬金幣。”

English (遊戲原文): Bought a Master Key off the Keymaster for 50,000 gold pieces.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 用 50,000 金幣從 Keymaster 購買了一把萬能鑰匙。

English (遊戲原文): The test of time has lain to waste the power of the true wand. Only the One can save it, yet at a cost of losing his old life...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 時間的考驗在於浪費真正魔杖的力量。只有獨一者才能拯救它，但代價是失去祂的舊命…

English (遊戲原文): You've entered the chambers of the Dead King.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你已經進入了死亡之王的密室。

English (遊戲原文): He doesn't look too pleased to see you.\n\nHe screams a curdling battle-cry and heads your way...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他看起來不太高興見到你。 \n\n他尖叫著一聲令人毛骨悚然的戰鬥吶喊，然後朝你走去…

English (遊戲原文): Scratchings on the wall read:\n\nTrachaem's task was always reversed. This is the paradox.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的刮痕寫著：\n\nTrachaem 的任務總是相反的。這就是悖論。

English (遊戲原文): Scratchings on the wall read:\n\nThe great one knew success at all points. Defeat was never etched on his destiny.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的划痕寫著：\n\n偉大的人在所有方面都知道成功。失敗從未銘刻在他的命運中。

English (遊戲原文): Scratchings on the wall read:\n\nHe was told to burn, and in that paradox knew a multitude of solutions.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的划痕寫著：\n\n他被告知要燃燒，而在這個悖論中他知道了多種解決方案。

English (遊戲原文): Scratchings on the wall read:\n\nThe great T had, at the end of things, to beg, with a kind word.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的划痕寫著：\n\n偉大的T在事情的最後不得不以一句善意的話來乞求。

English (遊戲原文): Scratchings on the wall read:\n\nThe strange mage wants two words: What Tr. did, in answer to the paradox, and what word he said at the end of things.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的刮痕寫著：\n\n奇怪的法師想要兩個字：What Tr。做了，以回答這個悖論，以及他在事情結束時所說的話。

English (遊戲原文): An old man (doing a fireball trick) wearing a garment of pure gold says:\n\n"The Name of it is the staff of:"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一位穿著純金衣服的老人（表演火球術）說：\n\n“它的名字是：”

English (遊戲原文):
"Correct. I will say this then: Go to the Sage, in the wilderness, and ask him of FANSKAR.
He will charge you a price, but the information will be valuable."

He suddenly disappears...
Chinese (請填寫中文):
「對。那我就這麼說吧：去荒野中的聖人那裡，向他詢問 FANSKAR 的情況。
他會向你收費，但這些信息很有價值。」

他突然消失了…

English (遊戲原文): "You again... You know the name of the staff. I shall let you pass."
Chinese (請填寫中文): “你又……你知道工作人員的名字，我就放你過去了。”

English (遊戲原文): A cloudy face appears, and says:\n\n"Your time draws to a close, mortals. Show the answer to me, or perish."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一張陰沉的臉出現了，說：\n\n“你們的時代即將結束，凡人。向我展示答案，否則就會滅亡。”

English (遊戲原文): Only a leader can show the way...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 只有領導者才能指明道路...

English (遊戲原文): A cloudy face appears, and says:\n\n"Very impressive. Your way lies clear, for the time being. But my time will come..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一張陰沉的臉出現了，說：\n\n“非常令人印象深刻。暫時你的路很清楚。但我的時間會到來......”

English (遊戲原文): There is an Old Warrior here.
There is a Toxic Giant here.
Since you are already sick, you tear into the toxic giant's body and pull out... A Torch!\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 既然你已經病了，你就撕裂有毒巨人的身體並拔出…火把！ \n\n

English (遊戲原文): Found a 'Torch!' in the body of a Toxic Giant
Chinese (請填寫中文): 找到了「火炬」！在劇毒巨人的體內

English (遊戲原文): There is a fountain here full of foul water.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一個噴泉，裡面充滿了污水。

English (遊戲原文): There is a fountain here, full of foul water. Who will drink?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一個噴泉，裡面充滿了污水。誰會喝？

English (遊戲原文): Drinking the water gave us poison.
There is a segment to The Scepter here.\n\n
You see some words etched on the wall:\n\nAge before all others, when time is short. For the last must be first.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你會看到牆上刻著一些文字：\n\n時間緊迫，年齡先於其他人。因為最後一個必須是第一個。

English (遊戲原文): On the wall (scrawled in old blood) is:\n\nPick yer poison, boys.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上（用舊血潦草地寫著）是：\n\n拿起你的毒藥，孩子們。

English (遊戲原文): Etched on the wall are these words:\n\nA party of sick people might escape where the healthy fail.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上刻著這樣的話：\n\n一群病人可能會逃脫，而健康人卻失敗了。

English (遊戲原文):
Etched in the wall is this rhyme:

The won flame in ancient grip
might cause the cloudy one to slip...
Chinese (請填寫中文):

English (遊戲原文): My name is Saradon, a wizard of some fame and little fortune. Though you know me not, and we have never met, I feel that I have known you all my life. For the story of your deeds, your entanglement with Mangar and his evil horde in Skara Brae, flows from the lips of every Bard throughout the Realm.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 我的名字叫薩拉頓，是一位頗有名氣但財富微薄的巫師。雖然你不認識我，我們也從未見過面，但我覺得我一生都認識你。因為你的事蹟、你與曼加爾以及他在斯卡拉布雷的邪惡部落的糾葛，從整個王國的每個吟遊詩人的嘴裡流傳出來。

English (遊戲原文): For this reason, for your courage and experience, I have contacted you above all others. For now we face an evil much greater than Mangar's. An evil that threatens not the safety and tranquility of but one city, nae... an evil that threatens the existence of the entire Realm and all the cities and citizens within!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 基於這個原因，為了你的勇氣和經驗，我先聯絡了你。現在我們面臨著比曼加爾更大的邪惡。一種邪惡不僅僅威脅一個城市的安全與安寧，不……一種威脅整個王國以及其中所有城市和公民的存在的邪惡！

English (遊戲原文): Recall now the lessons of your childhood. The story of Turin, the Archmage who forged the Destiny Wand in the molten depths of the holy mountain Krontor. The Destiny Wand, the uniting force which has rallied armies to the aid of the Realm, and has maintained peace and prosperity for the last 700 years.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 現在回想一下你童年的教訓。都靈的故事，大法師在克朗托聖山的熔岩深處鑄造了命運魔杖。命運魔杖，集結軍隊援助王國的團結力量，並在過去 700 年裡維持了和平與繁榮。

English (遊戲原文): But look around you now, where has the power of the Destiny Wand gone? Lawless mercenaries from the neighboring kingdom of Lestradae have invaded the Realm and now run rampant through the streets. Even in Tangramayne, our capital! It is they who have taken the Destiny Wand, with the guidance of an evil Archmage known as Lagoth Zanta.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 但現在看看你的周圍，命運魔杖的力量到哪裡去了？來自鄰國萊力量拉德的無法無天的傭兵入侵了王國，現在在街上猖獗。即使在我們的首都唐格拉瑪尼！正是他們在邪惡大法師拉格斯·贊塔的指導下拿走了命運魔杖。

English (遊戲原文): Although Lagoth has thwarted each of my attempts to gain knowledge of his powers and location, I have been able to discover that the Destiny Wand lies broken in seven pieces, at seven different locations. Lagoth has placed each fragment of the scepter within a Snare of Death - a puzzle room that will require all the wisdom and cunning at your disposal in order for you to survive.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 儘管拉戈斯挫敗了我了解他的力量和位置的每一次嘗試，但我已經能夠發現命運魔杖破碎成七塊，分佈在七個不同的位置。拉戈斯將權杖的每個碎片都放置在死亡陷阱中——這是一個謎題室，需要你運用所有的智慧和狡猾才能生存。

English (遊戲原文): Do you believe in legends?\n\nLegend states that, Unimaginable power is bestowed upon the one who reforges the Destiny Wand... Regardless of whether or not you hold faith in the stuff of legend, you must defeat Lagoth Zanta, regain the seven fragments, and reforge the Destiny Wand - it is the only way to save the Realm.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你相信傳說嗎？ \n\n傳說，重鑄命運魔杖的人會被賦予難以想像的力量……無論你是否相信傳說，你都必須擊敗拉格斯·贊塔，奪回七片碎片，重鑄命運魔杖——這是拯救王國的唯一方法。

English (遊戲原文): Now I must hurry, for in my attempts to glean knowledge of Lagoth, he has discovered my prying magic and even now his mercenaries approach. I care not for my own safety, but I pray that my magic is still strong enough to deliver this letter into your hands.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 現在我必須抓緊時間，因為當我試圖收集拉格斯的知識時，他已經發現了我的窺探魔法，甚至現在他的僱傭兵也已經逼近了。我不在乎自己的安全，但我祈禱我的魔法仍然強大到足以將這封信送到你的手中。

English (遊戲原文): My workshop contains powerful quest knowledge which I have gathered using magic and other, more physical, methods. Use it to help you during your quest. My only regret is that I cannot personally be there to counsel you during your quest. May fate smile upon you... and upon me.\n\nSaradon.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 我的工作室包含強大的任務知識，這些知識是我使用魔法和其他更物理的方法收集的。在你的探索過程中用它來幫助你。我唯一的遺憾是我不能親自在你的探索過程中為你提供建議。願命運向你微笑……也向我微笑。 \n\nSaradon。

English (遊戲原文):
You find a staff leaning against the bookshelf.

It has a note attached to it, which reads:

"This staff harmonizes the magical energies around it and channels them into the wielder, replenishing their spell points.

Take it, for it will surely provide some assistance to you on your journey, adventurers."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
你發現書架上斜靠著一根法杖。 

它上面附有一張紙條，上面寫著：

“這根法杖可以協調周圍的魔法能量，並將它們引導到持有者身上，補充他們的法術點。

拿上它吧，因為它一定會給你的冒險之旅提供一些幫助。”

English (遊戲原文): You find some handwritten notes from Saradon upon a stack of books. They read:\n\n"I've come across a spell of such power that a mage may only know it in transience. I first learnt of its existence in the Tombs, but to dream of wielding it one must delve into the Destiny Stone..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你在一疊書上發現了薩拉登的一些手寫筆記。他們讀到：\n\n“我遇到了一個咒語，其力量如此強大，法師可能只能短暫地知道它。我第一次在古墓中得知它的存在，但要想夢想使用它，就必須深入研究命運之石……”

English (遊戲原文): Some more notes lay here:\n\n"To learn the spell one must take five clues into the stone. But the order, it's all wrong..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡還有一些註釋：\n\n“要學習該咒語，必須將五個線索放入石頭中。但是順序，全錯了......”

English (遊戲原文): And another page reads:\n\n"The crypt holds the first, and a maze will lead you to the second..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 另一頁寫著：\n\n“地窖裡有第一個，迷宮會帶你到第二個…”

English (遊戲原文): And another page reads:\n\n"The third lies in a castle, and a fort for the fourth."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 另一頁寫著：\n\n“第三個位於城堡中，第四個位於堡壘中。”

English (遊戲原文): A final page reads:\n\n"A tall tower keeps the final secret."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 最後一頁寫著：\n\n“一座高塔保守著最後的秘密。”

English (遊戲原文): You find a note from Saradon's personal journal.\n\nThe mysterious appearance of the tower to the south is of great concern to me. Combined with the treachery of Oscon's betrayal to Count Waldec, things are at a boiling point. The time has come to seek help from abroad.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你從薩拉頓的個人日記中找到了一條筆記。 \n\n南邊塔樓的神秘外觀引起了我的極大關注。再加上奧斯康對瓦爾德克伯爵的背叛，事情已經到了沸點。現在是向國外尋求幫助的時候了。

English (遊戲原文): You're in the forest outside of Skara Brae
Chinese (請填寫中文): 您位於 Skara Brae 郊外的森林中

English (遊戲原文): You have stepped into the wilderness for the first time. Would you like a quick tutorial on the game controls before you proceed?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你第一次踏入荒野。在繼續之前，您想了解有關遊戲控制的快速教學嗎？

English (遊戲原文): Use W,A,S,D to move around the wilderness, or the cursor keys. You can also left click on the game view to move around.\n\nHold down right mouse on the game view and you can look around to take in the view.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使用 W、A、S、D 在荒野中移動，或使用遊標鍵。您也可以左鍵點擊遊戲視圖來移動。 \n\n在遊戲視圖上按住滑鼠右鍵，您可以環顧四周以查看視圖。

English (遊戲原文): That is all... You should start by investigating the ruins of Skara Brae in the valley below.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 就這些了……你應該從調查下面山谷中的斯卡拉布雷廢墟開始。

English (遊戲原文): To the north is the refugee camp.
You are next to Scrapwood Tavern.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 您位於 Scrapwood Tavern 旁。

English (遊戲原文): You are next to a small shrine.
Deeply hidden in verdant shadows, this grove, the Twilight Copse, is quiet and feels very peaceful.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這片樹林，暮光小樹林，深深隱藏在翠綠的陰影之中，很安靜，給人一種非常平和的感覺。

English (遊戲原文): Here, halfway up Earthdagger Mountain, winds swirl around and make this place earn its name: Cold Peak.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡位於地匕山的半山腰，風在周圍盤旋，使這個地方得名：冷峰。

English (遊戲原文): Amid the bountiful trees you find a bubbling Crystal Spring that almost glows with purity.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在茂密的樹木中，您會發現一處冒著氣泡的水晶泉水，幾乎閃爍著純淨的光芒。

English (遊戲原文): Lovingly tunneled into the mountainside, the opening to the Old Dwarf Mine looks natural.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 老矮人礦洞的隧道巧妙地深入山腰，看起來很自然。

English (遊戲原文): Stabbing up into the sky like an obsidian dagger, Shadow Rock is utterly alien to the surrounding landscape.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 暗影岩像一把黑曜石匕首一樣刺入天空，與周圍的景觀完全不同。

English (遊戲原文): The flat, grassy plain stretches peacefully out in all directions. This is the Vale of Lost Warriors.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 平坦、綠草如茵的平原向四方平靜地延伸。這裡就是失落勇士谷。

English (遊戲原文): Foul, noxious gases reeking of rotten eggs, bubble up through the turgid, yellow, mud-laden waters of Sulphur Springs.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 硫磺泉的渾濁、黃色、充滿泥漿的水中冒著臭雞蛋般的惡臭有毒氣體。

English (遊戲原文): The party sees the old review board to the east.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一行人看到舊的評審委員會在東邊。

English (遊戲原文): There is a statue of the Mad God Tarjan here. It's strange that it is clean and shiny as if someone has been caring for it.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一尊狂神塔爾揚的雕像。奇怪的是，它乾淨又閃亮，好像有人照顧過它一樣。

English (遊戲原文): Among the ruins of Skara Brae is an unnatural silence. As if death itself has come to stay.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 斯卡拉布雷的廢墟中有一種不自然的寂靜。彷彿死亡本身已經降臨。

English (遊戲原文): The feeling of evil is foreboding.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 邪惡的感覺是不祥的預感。

English (遊戲原文): To the east is the Temple of the Mad God.

"This is the temple of the Mad God. What is thy business, unbeliever?"

Speak to priest?
Chinese (請填寫中文):
「這是瘋神的神殿。你在做什麼，不信者？」

與神父交談？

English (遊戲原文):
"Only those who know the name of the Mad one are welcome."
What wilt thou say?
Chinese (請填寫中文):
「只歡迎那些知道瘋子名字的人。」
你會說什麼？

English (遊戲原文): "Speak not the name of the High one so loudly, lest he answer," the priest says. "Enter the catacombs, believer."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「不要大聲說出至高者的名字，以免他回答，」牧師說。 “進入地下墓穴，信徒。”

English (遊戲原文): "Welcome true believers! Follow the true path of Chaos and your destiny will come to you. Enter the realm of Brilhasti ap Tarj."
Chinese (請填寫中文): “歡迎真正的信徒！遵循混沌的真正道路，你的命運就會降臨到你身上。進入塔吉河畔布里哈斯蒂的領域。”

English (遊戲原文): "Welcome true believers! Enter the realm of shadow.\n\nBrilhasti awaits you!!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): “歡迎真正的信徒！進入暗影領域。\n\nBrilhasti 正在等待著你！！”

English (遊戲原文): "Welcome true believers! Those who live by the sword shall perish by the sword.\n\nBrilhasti awaits you!!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): “歡迎真正的信徒！靠劍生存的人將死於劍下。\n\n布里哈斯蒂在等著你！！”

English (遊戲原文): There are some stairs leading down into the catacombs.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 有一些樓梯通往地下墓穴。

English (遊戲原文): Under a pile of rubble that was once the home of Longinus, you see a limp, lifeless body, reaching to the sky as if for some final profound gesture.\n\nAlas, poor Longinus.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在曾經是朗吉努斯家的一堆瓦礫下，你看到一具無力、毫無生氣的屍體，伸向天空，彷彿在做最後的深刻姿態。 \n\n唉，可憐的朗吉努斯。

English (遊戲原文): A tattered note, written in the hand of Longinus the Mad reads:\n"Faith will not save you, nor belief, pray fate blesses you with a thief."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一張破爛的紙條，由瘋子朗吉努斯親手寫下：\n“信仰不能拯救你，信仰也不能拯救你，祈求命運賜予你一個小偷。”

English (遊戲原文):
You find a tattered note, written in the hand of Longinus the Mad. It reads:

"Faith will not save you, nor belief,
Pray fate blesses you with a thief."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
你發現了一張破爛的紙條，是瘋子朗吉努斯親手寫的。上面寫著：

“信仰救不了你，信仰也救不了你，
祈禱命運賜福給你一個小偷。”

English (遊戲原文): The last prophecy of Longinus the Mad.\n"Rage against it or sing its praises, A maze cares not if it amazes."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 瘋子朗吉努斯的最後預言。 \n“對它憤怒或歌頌它，迷宮不在乎它是否令人驚奇。”

English (遊戲原文):
This looks to be the last prophecy of Longinus the Mad...

"Rage against it or sing its praises,
A maze cares not if it amazes."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
這看起來是瘋子朗吉努斯的最後預言……

“對它憤怒或歌頌它，
迷宮不在乎它是否令人驚訝。”

English (遊戲原文): Original Game scenario design by Michael A. Stackpole.\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 由 Michael A. Stackpole 設計的原創遊戲場景。 \n

English (遊戲原文): Programming and Direction by Rebecca Ann Heineman.\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 麗貝卡·安·海涅曼 (Rebecca Ann Heineman) 的節目和指導。 \n
音樂由庫爾特·海登創作。 \n

English (遊戲原文): Playtesters: Bruce Schlickbernd, Rebecca Ann Heineman, Jennell Jaquays
Chinese (請填寫中文): 遊戲測試者：Bruce Schlickbernd、Rebecca Ann Heineman、Jennell Jaquays

English (遊戲原文): Through the rubble to the east you can see the scorched walls of Harkyn's Castle. In the distance, the partially toppled tower of Kylearan tells the tale of the good wizard's fate.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 透過東邊的廢墟，你可以看到哈肯城堡燒焦的牆壁。遠處，部分倒塌的凱利蘭塔講述這位善良巫師的命運故事。

English (遊戲原文): The collapsed remains of Roscoe's Energy Emporium lies before you to the north, its owner yet another victim of the Mad God's attack.
Chinese (請填寫中文): Roscoe能源商場倒塌的廢墟就在你面前的北邊，它的主人也是瘋神攻擊的另一個受害者。

English (遊戲原文): As you turn the corner, you think you hear singing and the skillful strumming of a lute?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 當你拐過街角時，你認為你聽到了歌聲和熟練的琵琶彈奏聲嗎？

English (遊戲原文): To the south is all that remains of the old Dragonbreath Inn. You can clearly hear a melody now, cutting through the still smouldering wreckage of the tavern.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 南面是舊龍息旅店的全部遺跡。現在你可以清楚地聽到一段旋律，穿過酒館仍在冒煙的廢墟。

English (遊戲原文): Reaching into the sky, Valarian's Tower stands as a monument for what once was.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 瓦拉里安之塔高聳入雲，如同一座紀念碑，展現了曾經的面貌。

English (遊戲原文): Foul noxious fumes rise from a gaping pit.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 惡臭的有毒煙霧從大坑中升起。

English (遊戲原文): The finger of the lake shimmers in a natural glow all its own.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 湖水的手指閃爍著自然的光芒。

English (遊戲原文): An old hut sits by the shore of a beautiful lake. Fishing equipment is stacked neatly against the hut's wall.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一座古老的小屋坐落在美麗的湖邊。釣魚用具整齊地靠著小屋的牆壁堆放。

English (遊戲原文): The ground is littered with acorns.

You see a large oak tree here, and the ground is littered with acorns.

Do you want to pick a fresh acorn off the tree?
Chinese (請填寫中文):
你在這裡看到一棵大橡樹，地上散落著橡子。 

你想從樹上摘一個新鮮的橡實嗎？

English (遊戲原文): This field is full of beautiful flowers that float and dance on the light breezes.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這片田野上開滿了美麗的花朵，在微風中翩翩起舞。

English (遊戲原文): There is a large pile of Arefolia leaves here.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一大堆沙葉草的葉子。

English (遊戲原文): \n\nDo you want to gather some leaves?
Hawkslayer alerts you that he has important items that you should take with you before you leave!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 鷹殺手提醒您，他有重要物品，您在離開之前應該隨身攜帶！

English (遊戲原文): You see a deep, dark pit scarring the land like a wound.\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你看到一個又深又黑的坑，像傷口一樣傷痕累累。 \n

English (遊戲原文): Do you wish to enter it?
You are inside a an old, battered tower.\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你在一座破舊的塔樓裡。 \n

English (遊戲原文): Do you wish to climb up?
Beneath the waves of the lake, you see a building.\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在湖水的波浪下，你看到一棟建築物。 \n

English (遊戲原文): An old fisherman is here. He says, "For a few pieces of thy gold, I'll let thee in on a few secrets."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 來了一位老漁夫。他說：“只要你幾塊金子，我就可以告訴你一些秘密。”

English (遊戲原文): Shall thou give some gold to the fisherman?\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你可以給漁夫一些黃金嗎？ \n\n

English (遊戲原文): "Well be that way!" shouts the fisherman. He eats a can of spinach and then promptly throws you out of his home.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「那就這樣吧！」漁夫喊道。他吃了一罐菠菜，然後立刻把你趕出了他的家。

English (遊戲原文): Whom shall give him some gold?
"Here is a spell called 'Gilles Gills' that will let thee breathe underwater. Just say GILL and thee can explore the life spring in the Crystal Palace."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「這裡有一個叫做『吉爾斯吉爾斯』的咒語，可以讓你在水下噴吐。只要說吉爾，你就可以探索水晶宮裡的生命之泉。”

English (遊戲原文): "And don't forget to take something to carry the 'Water of Life' in, that stuff hath many healing and life giving properties!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): “別忘了帶一些東西來攜帶‘生命之水’，那東西有很多治療和賦予生命的特性！”

English (遊戲原文): Who wants to learn Gilles Gills?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 誰想學習吉爾斯·吉爾斯？

English (遊戲原文): "I cannot teach thee, thou art not a magic user."
"I cannot teach thee, thou knowest this spell already."

English (遊戲原文): The carcass of Tslotha Garnath is here and it sure smells pretty bad.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 特斯洛薩·加納斯的屍體就在這裡，聞起來確實很臭。

English (遊戲原文): The Palace's beauty has been washed out by the centuries beneath the water, but its majesty is undiminished. The water is dark, yet warm, and you -- an air breather -- feel curiously welcome.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 宮殿的美麗已經被水淹沒了幾個世紀，但它的威嚴絲毫沒有減弱。水是黑色的，但溫暖，而你——一個噴吐空氣的人——感到奇怪的受歡迎。

English (遊戲原文): Bubbling up through a hole in the floor is a glowing stream of water that fills the room. Your spirits feel joyful and the pains of recent combat are forgotten. Such is the nature of the Life Spring.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一股發光的水流從地板上的一個洞裡冒出來，充滿了整個房間。你的精神感到愉悅，最近戰鬥的痛苦都被忘記了。這就是生命之泉的本質。

English (遊戲原文): {0} collects some of the magical water.
{0} casts Gilles Gills - and now the party can breathe underwater!
Chinese (請填寫中文): {0}聘請吉爾斯吉爾斯 (Gilles Gills) - 現在隊伍可以在水下噴吐了！

English (遊戲原文): Beyond the shattered door you see a floor littered with dust and dry leaves. You see some signs of small animals, but, beyond that, you see no signs of normal life.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 透過破碎的門，你可以看到地板上散落著灰塵和乾樹葉。你會看到一些小動物的跡象，但除此之外，你看不到正常生命的跡象。

English (遊戲原文): An old tapestry adorns the wall here, it depicts a beautiful castle underneath a lake.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡的牆上裝飾著一幅古老的掛毯，描繪了湖下一座美麗的城堡。

English (遊戲原文): Something here feels wrong. You sense the tower has been violated and, while you are not the offending party, you will share in the tower's wrath.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡感覺有些不對勁。你感覺到塔樓被侵犯了，雖然你不是冒犯者，但你會分擔塔樓的憤怒。

English (遊戲原文): The Water of Life has many regenerative powers.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 生命之水俱有許多再生能力。

English (遊戲原文): This level shows fewer signs of neglect, yet talon-slashes through bright murals suggest something has contemptuously desecrated Valarian's private demesne.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這一層沒有太多被忽視的跡象，但明亮的壁畫上的爪子划痕表明有東西輕蔑地褻瀆了瓦拉里安的私人領地。

English (遊戲原文): You see a huge oak tree supporting a large stone disk.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你看到一棵巨大的橡樹支撐著一個大石盤。

English (遊戲原文): A round portal blocks your way into the central core. On the massive stone disk you see a carving of an oak tree holding a similar disk up.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個圓形的傳送門擋住了你進入中央核心的道路。在巨大的石盤上，您可以看到一棵橡樹的雕刻，上面托著一個類似的石盤。 \n\n

English (遊戲原文): You see an acorn sized hole in the ground.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你會看到地上有一個橡子大小的洞。

English (遊戲原文): You see an acorn planted here.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你看到這裡種著一顆橡實。

English (遊戲原文): {0} waters the acorn, but nothing seems to happen.
Chinese (請填寫中文): {0}給橡子澆水，但似乎什麼事也沒發生。

English (遊戲原文): The acorn, saturated with the Water of Life, bursts into verdant action and a seedling rises up like Atlas, lifting the disk up and letting you pass freely.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 浸透了生命之水的橡子突然綻放出翠綠的氣息，一顆幼苗像阿特拉斯一樣升起，抬起圓盤，讓你自由通過。

English (遊戲原文): Seek the Water of Life in the Crystal Palace.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在水晶宮尋找生命之水。

English (遊戲原文): This level appears inviolate, which you should take as little consolation. Instead of fearing the beasts lurking below, you now face whatever has kept them from this level in the first place.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個水平看起來是不可侵犯的，你應該對此感到一點安慰。現在你不再害怕潛伏在下面的野獸，而是先面對那些阻止它們進入這一層的一切。

English (遊戲原文): Hidden away in this secret closet you see the gleaming Nightspear. No lights reflect from it, and the black metal looks like a slice from the starry night sky.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在這個秘密衣櫥裡，你可以看到閃閃發光的夜矛。它沒有反射任何光線，黑色金屬看起來就像是星空夜空的切片。 \n\n

English (遊戲原文): Two emotions thread the Sacred Grove. Despite the autumnal coloring, you feel life and peace here. Beneath that, though, a bitter taste of evil fills the air. The Grove has been invaded!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 兩種情緒貫穿聖林。儘管已是秋日的色彩，但在這裡你仍能感受到生機與寧靜。然而，在這之下，空氣中瀰漫著邪惡的苦澀味道。格羅夫被入侵了！

English (遊戲原文): The archway to the elven city is here. Do you wish to leave the grove?\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 通往精靈城的拱門就在這裡。你想離開樹林嗎？ \n\n

English (遊戲原文): Through the gilded bars of the door between you and the tomb entrance, you see the flickering eternal flame. In its blue-white light you see writing on the walls within.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 透過你和墳墓入口之間的鍍金門閂，你可以看到閃爍的永恆火焰。在藍白色的光線下，你可以看到裡面牆壁上的文字。

English (遊戲原文): There is a bowl in a cavity in Valarian's chest.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 瓦拉里安胸口的空腔裡有一個碗。

English (遊戲原文): Small tubes jut out of the rim of the bowl.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 小管子從碗的邊緣伸出。

English (遊戲原文): There is a heart in the bowl.
There is a living, beating heart in the bowl.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 碗裡有一顆活生生的、跳動的心臟。

English (遊戲原文): The door to the tomb looks like Valarian himself standing tall. The words beside the tomb read:
Chinese (請填寫中文): 墳墓的門看起來就像瓦拉里安本人高高地站著。墓旁刻著這樣的字：

English (遊戲原文): "In life my heart knew but one ache, one task undone. Heal that pain so I may rest, and what is mine is yours."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「在生活中，我的心只知道一種疼痛，一項未完成的任務。治愈這種痛苦，這樣我就可以休息了，我的就是你的。”

English (遊戲原文): The eternal flame bursts forth in a beautiful blue display which dazzles the eye.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 永恆的火焰爆發出美麗的藍色，令人眼花撩亂。

English (遊戲原文): Unfortunately, it also singed your hair. You seem to be well done.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 不幸的是，它也燒焦了你的頭髮。看來你做得很好。

English (遊戲原文): Valarian's burial chamber appears to be intact. Murals depicting his valiant deeds cover the walls of his resting place.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 瓦拉里安的墓室似乎完好無損。他安息之地的牆壁上覆蓋著描繪他英勇事蹟的壁畫。

English (遊戲原文): The bow that once belonged to the great Valarian is here.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 曾經屬於偉大的瓦拉里安的弓就在這裡。 \n\n

English (遊戲原文): The quiver of arrows that Valarian once fought his battles with are here.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 瓦拉里安曾經用來戰鬥的箭袋就在這裡。 \n\n

English (遊戲原文): The heart of Tslotha Garnath is in the bowl.
Chinese (請填寫中文): Tslotha Garnath 的心臟就在碗裡。

English (遊戲原文): {0} places the heart in the bowl.
{0} waters the heart, but nothing seems to happen.
Chinese (請填寫中文): {0}心如止水，但似乎什麼事都沒有發生。

English (遊戲原文): The beating heart of Tslotha Garnath is in the bowl, pumping fluids.
Chinese (請填寫中文): Tslotha Garnath 跳動的心臟位於碗中，並泵送液體。

English (遊戲原文): The heart, invigorated by the Water of Life, begins pumping fluid through the little tubes attached to the bowl.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 心臟在生命之水的滋潤下，開始透過連接在碗上的小管泵送液體。

English (遊戲原文): Inch thick sheets of ice coat the tower walls. Stone carvings, barely visible beneath the icy sheath, remind you of the splendor that once was Castle Lanatir.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 塔壁上覆蓋著一吋厚的冰層。冰冷的外殼下幾乎看不見的石雕讓您想起拉納提爾城堡曾經的輝煌。

English (遊戲原文): There is a passageway here, going down. Do you wish to take it?\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有個通道，往下走。你想接受嗎？ \n\n

English (遊戲原文): There are stairs that continue up into the highest levels, or down to towards the exit.\nWhat would you like to do?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 有樓梯可以繼續往上到達最高層，或是往下到達出口。 \n您想做什麼？

English (遊戲原文): Light shimmers over the ice on the north wall and reveals a brightly painted mural. It features a young Hawkslayer and a dozen baleful creatures locked in mortal combat. The painting is old in style, yet no less beautiful for it.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 光線在北牆上的冰上閃爍，露出一幅色彩鮮豔的壁畫。它的主角是一名年輕的鷹殺手和十幾個陷入殊死搏鬥的邪惡生物。這幅畫風格古老，但美麗程度絲毫不減。

English (遊戲原文): There are stairs here that lead higher into the tower, or back down to the exit.\nWhat would you like to do?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有樓梯可以通往更高的塔樓，或向下通往出口。 \n你想做什麼？

English (遊戲原文): Shattered ice on the wall reveals a small carving that reads: Cala and Hawkslayer, New Age, Anno Uno and eternity.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的碎冰露出了一個小雕刻，上面寫著：卡拉和鷹手、新時代、紀元和永恆。

English (遊戲原文): A small crib is here. Engraved in a heart shaped border is "Hawkslayer and Cala" and underneath this emblem is the name "Utor"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一個小嬰兒床。心形邊框上刻有“Hawkslayer 和 Cala”，徽章下方刻有“Utor”的名字

English (遊戲原文): The rime crusted walls are a perfect example of antique architecture long since lost to the world you call home. The frozen beauty of this tower is a priceless treasure you will carry with you always.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 結霜的牆壁是古董建築的完美典範，早已消失在您稱之為家的世界中。這座塔的冰凍之美是您永遠隨身攜帶的無價之寶。

English (遊戲原文): In a flash of brilliant white light, the party comes face to face with the keepers of the white tower.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一道耀眼的白光閃過，一行人與白塔的守護者面對面。

English (遊戲原文): "Chickens, fight like men!!" says a white wizard.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「雞們，像男人一樣戰鬥吧！！」一位白巫師說。

English (遊戲原文): On a small pedestal that was once guarded by the White Wizards is a Crystal Lens.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在曾經由白巫師看守的一個小基座上有一個水晶透鏡。 \n\n

English (遊戲原文): Several bodies are stacked here and they look like they have been run through a food processor.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 幾具屍體堆在這裡，看起來像是經過食品加工機處理過的。

English (遊戲原文): This grey tower has an odd feel to it. Ice fills it, yet here has an ethereal aspect. It does seem, curiously, as if the ice is here only because the tower does not take notice of it.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這座灰色的塔給人一種奇怪的感覺。裡面充滿了冰，但這裡卻有一種空靈的感覺。奇怪的是，冰之所以在這裡，似乎只是因為塔沒有註意到它。

English (遊戲原文): There is a passageway here, going down. Do you wish to take it?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有個通道，往下走。你想接受嗎？

English (遊戲原文): This level feels odd because the walls warp and change. The light wavers and dims, making you unsure of everything you see.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個關卡感覺很奇怪，因為牆壁會變形和變化。光線忽隱忽現，讓你對所看到的一切都不確定。

English (遊戲原文): This level's icy chill seeps deep in through your flesh and sucks the warmth from your bones. It feels almost alive, and malevolent. The dark miasma leeches your courage away and leaves you very uneasy.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這一層的冰冷深入你的肉體，吸走你骨頭的溫暖。感覺幾乎還活著，而且充滿惡意。黑暗的瘴氣會吸走你的勇氣，讓你感到非常不安。

English (遊戲原文): Broken cross is the goal, yet hidden it doth be. Through the flaw egress is won, but peril is not lost. Win the lens, one third your prize, but at what cost?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 破碎的十字架是目標，但它確實是隱藏的。透過缺陷，可以逃脫，但不會失去危險。贏得鏡頭，三分之一的獎金，但代價是什麼？

English (遊戲原文): In a flash of dim grey light, the party comes face to face with the keepers of the grey tower.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在一道昏暗的灰色光芒中，一行人與灰色塔的守護者面對面。

English (遊戲原文): "Chickens!! Fight like men!!" shouts a grey wizard.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「雞！！像男人一樣戰鬥！！」一個灰色巫師大喊。

English (遊戲原文): On a small pedestal that was once guarded by the Grey Wizards is a Smokey Lens.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在曾經由灰巫師守衛的一個小基座上有一個煙熏透鏡。 \n\n

English (遊戲原文): Several bodies are stacked here and they look like they have been run through La Machine.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 幾具屍體堆在這裡，看起來就像是被機器運轉過。

English (遊戲原文): You know it seems mad, and you can sense things in the darkness, but you see nothing, absolutely not a thing, making up the foundation of the Black Tower!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你知道這看起來很瘋狂，你可以感應到黑暗中的東西，但你什麼也看不見，絕對沒有任何東西構成了黑塔的基礎！

English (遊戲原文): Again you see a level without visible barriers, but you feel this place is not as formless as the level below. You do know evil dwells in its black heart.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你再次看到一個沒有明顯障礙的樓層，但你感覺這個地方並不像下面的樓層那麼無形。你確實知道邪惡住在它的黑色內心。

English (遊戲原文): As you climb higher in the Black Tower, the fabric of reality, though twisted and weird, becomes stronger. Chittering howls and gibbering laughter echoes throughout the void you now face.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 當你在黑塔中爬得更高時，現實的結構雖然扭曲而怪異，但卻變得更強大。嘰嘰喳喳的嚎叫和胡言亂語的笑聲在你現在面對的虛空中迴響。

English (遊戲原文): As you step into this area, you see a vision of a dark circle eclipsing a scarlet moon. The moon vanishes, and the dark disk pulses with vibrant and ebon power.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 當你踏入這個區域時，你會看到一個黑圈遮住了猩紅的月亮。月亮消失了，黑暗的圓盤閃爍著充滿活力的黑檀之力。

English (遊戲原文): In the darkest part of the room, the party comes face to face with the keepers of the black tower.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在房間最黑暗的地方，一行人與黑塔的守護者面對面。

English (遊戲原文): "Chickens!! Fight like men!!" shouts a black wizard.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「雞！！像男人一樣戰鬥！！」一個黑巫師大喊。

English (遊戲原文): On a small pedestal that was once guarded by the Black Wizards is a Black Lens.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在曾經由黑巫師看守的一個小基座上有一個黑色透鏡。 \n\n

English (遊戲原文): Several bodies are stacked here and they look like they have been run through a garbage disposal.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡堆放著幾具屍體，看起來像是垃圾處理場處理過的。

English (遊戲原文): A stairway leads up to the Ice Keep.
A stairway leading up to the Ice Keep is here. Do you wish to take it?\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有通往冰堡的樓梯。你想接受嗎？ \n\n

English (遊戲原文): Unlike the rest of the castle, the dungeon gives mute evidence of the invasion's fierce fighting. Debris is scattered about and bodies lie encased in icy coffins.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 與城堡的其他部分不同，地下城提供了入侵者激烈戰鬥的無聲證據。碎片散落一地，屍體被裝在冰冷的棺材裡。

English (遊戲原文): Dead creatures litter the floor here, and your skin crawls with the overwhelming sense of latent magic.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 死去的生物散落在地板上，你的皮膚因潛在魔法的壓倒性感覺而爬行。

English (遊戲原文): A sign reads:\nHere lies Lanatir, last guardian of all magics. Only in the name of his blood may you enter.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一塊牌子上寫著：\n這裡長眠著拉納提爾，所有魔法的最後守護者。只有以他的血的名義你才可以進入。

English (遊戲原文): Radiating with an inner glow all its own, Lanatir's Wand of Power gives an aura of incredible power.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 拉納提爾的力量魔杖本身散發著內在的光芒，給人一種難以置信的力量光環。 \n\n

English (遊戲原文): Warm to the touch, the Sphere of Lanatir seems to want to be used in the name of Good.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 拉納提爾球體摸起來很溫暖，似乎想以善良的名義使用。 \n\n

English (遊戲原文): A stone guardian asks the party:\n\n"Speak your name, defender, and pass a friend."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一名石頭守護者要求隊伍：\n\n“說出你的名字，守護者，並傳遞一位朋友。”

English (遊戲原文): The solid, ice-laden walls of this massive castle help hold the savage storm outside. Even so, the keep is not warm and the danger of frosty death stays with you even here.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這座巨大城堡堅固的、覆蓋著冰的牆壁有助於抵禦外面的猛烈風暴。即便如此，要塞並不溫暖，即使在這裡，凍死的危險仍然伴隨著你。

English (遊戲原文): There is a passageway here, going up. Do you wish to take it?\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有個通道，往上走。你想接受嗎？ \n\n

English (遊戲原文): There is a passageway here to the White Tower.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一條通往白塔的通道。

English (遊戲原文):
Scrawled on the wall you see:

Lift the veil,
Then counter it,
False door frees,
True door.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
你看到的牆上潦草地寫著：

揭開面紗，
然後對抗它，
假門被釋放，
真門。

English (遊戲原文): A shimmering magical curtain that looks very much like an Aurora Borealis, shifts and sways between you and a doorway.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 閃閃發光的魔法窗簾，看起來非常像北極光，在您和門口之間移動和搖擺。

English (遊戲原文): The magical curtain dissipates into a light mist.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 魔法布幕消散成淡淡的霧氣。
我的‘相位門’咒語被吸收了。
